The following events took place in '''1582 [[Galactic Standard Calendar|BBY]]'''.

==Events==
*A military coup in the [[Tapani Empire]] brought down the [[Kappela Dynasty]].
*Region forms the [[Tapani Federation]].
*The coup marks the transition from the [[Dynastic Era]] to the [[Federal Era]] of the region.
